title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: 2 weeks before Rin and Len's anniversary
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright! Let's all think of a gift that'll render Len speechless!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sorry for getting all of you involved in this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not a problem at all. He's helped us out a lot, and it's for his anniversary, after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly! I think there's also an anniversary event happening for Rin and Len in Shibuya, so there's no way we wouldn't celebrate here too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even so... We were a little surprised to hear that you two decided to have a competition over who can blow the other away with their gift.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Same here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it sounds like something you two would do, and it makes things interesting!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Since all of you here are on my team, I need you to think really hard of gifts that'll knock Len's socks off! Okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We got it. But, you got any ideas so far?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm. If KAITO was here, we could've asked him a bunch of stuff... But the other team snagged him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, but we have MEIKO.
If we're going to gift food, then we'll be able to match it to Len's exact preferences, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I actually made a note of Len's current favorite foods and drinks just in case.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I knew we could count on you, MEIKO!
Shall we brainstorm some food ideas, then?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We could...
Not sure if food would render him speechless, though...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If anything, a gift that I couldn't have come up with on my own would be ideal!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Something you couldn't have come up with...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh. Then, how about this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm sure Rin's thinking that all we need to do is surprise each other, so I bet she's thinking of a way to do just that.
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But anniversaries are a time for gifts, so I think it'd be better to put her at a loss for words by making her happy or moved!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So that's why you suggested making a memory scrapbook.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But are there any memories that would have that effect on her? It'd probably just be the event you guys did for Kohane and the others, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now wait, hold on. Ordinary days, fun conversations or even yummy food you've shared together make for wonderful memories, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially if the person with you is your partner.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... I didn't know you were such a romanticist.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's not like that exactly...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's just, anything we do together is always so much fun and I can't help but enjoy being with her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
M-More importantly!
Kohane, Toya, did you bring the stuff I asked for?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I've brought some masking tape, stickers and anything else we could use to decorate the scrapbook!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've also printed out photos of nice moments from our practice videos.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I never thought we would use practice videos for something like this. I suppose we should be grateful for your diligence.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What do you think about this photo, Len?
It's completely focused on Rin singing at the back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh! That's a cool photo! Let's use it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I think this was when Kohane and the others came to practice after not visiting for a while. Rin and I got so excited that we went full out singing.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Our throats were so wrecked after we finished that we chugged down so much juice.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow! Your cutting is so neat, Toya! 
Even if I draw an outline, mine still turns out bad... How are you able to cut circles and hearts so well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you having trouble with the curves? In that case, try rotating the paper instead and that should help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rotate the paper? Sounds hard, but I'll give it a shot.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Rin would probably prefer circles and hearts instead of squares...)
Rin and Len's anniversary

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The day has finally come...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A competition is a competition. No hard feelings, alright?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You got this, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All she has to do is give him the gift, though...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I beg to differ. Hyping it up is very important too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know you can do it, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll go first!
My gift is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A watercolor portrait of you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whaaaaat?!
Watercolor? Portrait?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! This is amazing! That's me!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She really got your hair and eyes too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It has a nice, warm touch to it that can only really be achieved with watercolor.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I know, it's amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-It's good enough, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, my turn! Get ready for my gift!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ta-da! It's a scrapbook full of memories!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A scrapbook?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup! The decorating turned out great too. Here, look!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wh-What the?! It's so cute! There's so many photos and stickers in here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This photo! This is when we all practiced together, right?! I remember we drank so much juice after!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup! We drank the whole supply and Luka got all mopey!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Rin. Flip this photo to the right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh! Hahaha! There's a drawing of mopey Luka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oooh, that's a nice touch.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's amazing! It's already nice as it is, but now this just makes you want to find all the other hidden goodies!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, Rin. How was my gift? I'd say it's pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I guess. It was a little different to what I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, shall we decide the winner?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin, Len, on the count of three, say the name of the person you think won this competition. If you think you won, then say your own name, alright?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Who surprised the other person with their gift the best?
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Len!
Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess it's a tie.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! Len!
You were so smug before, why didn't you say your own name?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I should be asking you that! You were the one laughing like you knew you were going to win!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, alright! This just means both of your gifts are equally amazing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's right. You're partners.
That's why you two were able to successfully surprise each other.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: True!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, Len. Let's go through the scrapbook together! I wanna hear about how you made this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure! I wanna hear about this portrait too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, why don't you two do that over on the terrace?
In the meantime, we'll prepare for your anniversary party.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay!
